Florida Takes Its Election Playbook National

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/grantdemocracy/grant-report-october-8-2026?e=c16f400a56)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/2krHCHMeiN_?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a)
| | **Florida Takes Its Election Playbook National****By Justin Riemer, President, USGI** Florida Governor Ron DeSantis and Secretary of State Cord Byrd want other states to copy Florida’s election policies.
On September 24, DeSantis and Byrd [announced](https://us.list-manage.com/qYOO39sWOZN?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) the Association of State and Local Election Officials (ASLEO), a new organization that will train election administrators and promote policies based on Florida’s approach. Byrd, who plans to lead the group after November’s election, said, “We want to take the Florida blueprint and take it nationwide.” The announcement was made in conjunction with news that state prosecutors had indicted 20 individuals for election crimes, most of whom are noncitizens charged with registering and voting illegally.
The governor highlighted various Florida policies as a blueprint ASLEO will work to enact outside the state, particularly those that speed up ballot counting. The governor also highlighted the state’s Office of Election Crimes and Security, an [agency](https://us.list-manage.com/F05hjfOky9w?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) dedicated to investigating fraud and irregularities in coordination with state prosecutors and its efforts to rein in ballot petition fraud. The latest indictments bring the office’s total to more than 100 arrests and prosecutions since its creation in 2022.
It remains to be seen the extent to which ASLEO will compete with organizations like the National Association of State Election Directors (NASED) and the Election Center that offer training and credentialing or just primarily focus on lobbying and policy advocacy.
Regarding policy, ASLEO has a compelling story to tell about how Florida transformed its elections in the last quarter-century since its embarrassing time under the microscope in the 2000 recount. Lack of clear and uniform ballot counting and recount standards, problems with ballot design and voting systems, and local election official incompetence dominated headlines for years, but Florida eventually started figuring things out. Now, even critics of Florida’s efforts to tighten its voting processes must at least begrudgingly acknowledge its emergence as a national leader in mastering the nuts and bolts of election administration and the professionalism of its election officials.
Even setting aside disputed list maintenance, proof of citizenship, or voter ID policies, Florida sets the standard for efficient ballot counting, leaving even the New York Times to note that “Florida Counts Its Election Ballots Fast,” and asking, “Why Can’t California Keep Up?” Despite ranking third in state population and spanning two time zones, Florida reports its results faster than any other state, thanks to its Election Day ballot receipt deadline, generous pre-election processing allowances, and statutory deadlines for completing the count. In the 2024 General Election, Florida had [counted more than 81 percent](https://us.list-manage.com/lrutiT66jiT?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) of its vote by about 8 p.m. Eastern when the AP called the race, roughly an hour after polls closed across most of the state. California, by contrast, took nearly a month to finish counting its 2024 general election ballots.
Good policy only means so much if you don’t have effective administrators to implement it. And even as the legislature hammered away at fixing pervasive weaknesses in state election law, Florida was still held back by pockets of incompetent local election administration, particularly in [Palm Beach](https://us.list-manage.com/9UtT2uSk8qD?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) and [Broward](https://us.list-manage.com/olGM5JVWUL0?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) counties. So the state stepped in: Governor Rick Scott suspended Broward Supervisor of Elections Brenda Snipes in 2018, and Governor DeSantis suspended Palm Beach Supervisor Susan Bucher in 2019, sidelining the officials in those continuously poor performing counties. And even though Florida’s county Supervisors of Elections are elected, voters have generally chosen competent, serious administrators.
Whether progressive states like California, Illinois, or New York will be receptive to ASLEO outreach remains to be seen. But it could be impactful by directing its efforts in those types of states to less controversial reforms including those that would speed up ballot counting.
As far as more contentious policy changes, Florida has been sued as much as any state over its election reforms, but those challenges have been largely unsuccessful. For those states looking to model Florida policy on absentee voting verification, registration safeguards, and others, ASLEO can offer them a battle-tested blueprint.
It’s also important to note that Florida has improved its elections and tightened its processes while keeping voting easy. It continues to offer no-excuse absentee voting, a generous early voting period, and smooth Election Day voting all while delivering quick, accurate, and trustworthy election results. If ASLEO can sell that combination of speed, security, and access, it may attract a more diverse array of states that are willing to listen than some may anticipate.

| | **Arizona** The Maricopa County Attorney [reported](https://us.list-manage.com/16FAljXhzie?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) that of 60 voters the County Recorder referred as possible noncitizens after SAVE checks, 52 were citizens and eight were not, and that seven of the eight had been registered while renewing driver’s licenses. No charges were announced.Runbeck Election Services [mailed](https://us.list-manage.com/1dawlDEKLlA?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) 3,126 Maricopa County early ballots six days ahead of schedule after a separately processed pallet was released with other outgoing mail. The Recorder’s Office said the ballots went to the correct voters and remain valid.**California** The Riverside County Registrar of Voters [received](https://us.list-manage.com/CfCilURhCft?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) the roughly 650,000 ballots and election materials the sheriff’s office had seized, following the Supreme Court of California’s order to return them.Shasta County Clerk Clint Curtis [oversaw the shredding](https://us.list-manage.com/_RvcoZHfI1I?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) of the county’s roughly 50,000 November 2024 ballots. The shredding came weeks after the 22-month retention period ended September 5, and after Curtis had twice delayed destruction amid warnings from the county and the Secretary of State’s office.**Connecticut** Former state Senator Dennis Bradley was [charged](https://us.list-manage.com/P0GpV8nGSnT?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) with absentee ballot violations after investigators said he opened a Bridgeport voter’s completed absentee ballot and told her to change her vote in the August Democratic probate primary, in which his brother was a candidate.**Florida** Governor Ron DeSantis and Attorney General James Uthmeier [announced](https://us.list-manage.com/urpbJxorsx6?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) indictments of 20 people on election-fraud charges brought by the Statewide Prosecutor. At least three-quarters of those charged are noncitizens, and the rest are felons who had not had their voting rights restored and voters who cast ballots in more than one jurisdiction.**Georgia** The Georgia State Election Board [asked](https://us.list-manage.com/LPTc54TFcOg?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) the U.S. Department of Justice to investigate concerns about the state’s voting system ahead of the November election. In a letter to U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche, State Election Board Executive Director James Mills asked the DOJ to require a software update and prohibit QR-code tabulation.The State Election Board [adjourned](https://us.list-manage.com/YHSbcggqAKh?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) without voting on a Georgia Republican Party and Republican National Committee proposal to require poll workers to shuffle ballots before they are cast. Days earlier, the Board had passed a resolution urging Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger to update voting-system software to close a flaw that can allow ballots to be matched to the voters who cast them.**Illinois** DuPage County [suspended](https://us.list-manage.com/vVNyMQCkzf_?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) early voting at all five sites on its first day after the voter-registration system pulled registration dates in place of birth dates and a candidate was left off ballots. The county also held back mail ballots until the following week.Champaign County [suspended](https://us.list-manage.com/dCdsUfEIA28?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) early voting at its only early voting site from Friday through the weekend over an unspecified technical issue before reopening.Kane County [sent](https://us.list-manage.com/pqdMltcqK0F?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) about 2,000 voters duplicate mail ballots after its ballot-printing system could not confirm which ballots had printed. The clerk told recipients to disregard the duplicate.**Kansas** Attorney General Kobach [ordered](https://us.list-manage.com/IH_pSrKx0s9?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) the League of Women Voters of Kansas and its Leavenworth chapter to stop giving $5 gift cards to students who registered to vote at two high school drives in May, citing federal and state bans on paying people to register. The Attorney General referred the matter to the U.S. Attorney for the District of Kansas.**Kentucky** Campbell County’s online sample ballot [omitted](https://us.list-manage.com/XRg0Bw2l_SF?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) the Fourth Congressional District race, an error the county clerk traced to the ballot vendor’s files. The error did not affect printed ballots or voting equipment.**Louisiana** The Secretary of State’s office [misclassified](https://us.list-manage.com/8AX_z6RG9sJ?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) about 67,000 voters as inactive during routine database maintenance and said it was restoring their status and had added safeguards.**Michigan** A Park Township woman was [charged](https://us.list-manage.com/9vST0ELRCow?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) with felony absentee ballot tampering after township election workers found that she had signed and returned her two adult children’s ballots in the August primary.Antrim County and at least one Presque Isle County township [missed](https://us.list-manage.com/zXepmN_FJgU?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) the September 24 statutory deadline to mail absentee ballots 40 days before the election, with clerks citing a shortage of approved ballot printers and a compressed primary-to-general calendar.Wayne County [arranged](https://us.list-manage.com/FN2uYSAYZEX?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) to mail corrected absentee ballots to about 10,000 voters in Belleville, Sumpter Township, and Van Buren Township after a printing error left the Belleville Area District Library Board races off the ballot.Blind voters and disability advocates [raised concerns](https://us.list-manage.com/374Duoa40M0?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) that Detroit’s accessible voter terminals frequently malfunction and that poll workers are not trained to set them up, and the City Council president pledged to address the problems before November.**Minnesota** Pine County [told](https://us.list-manage.com/YU1FS4fwJf2?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) more than 200 City of Finlayson voters that votes in a township hospital district write-in race, which the vendor mistakenly printed on their mail ballots, will not be counted.**Nevada** Secretary of State Aguilar’s office [said](https://us.list-manage.com/urvcKH5WFp1?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) its registration records gave no indication that any of the 185 voters the Department of Homeland Security flagged as noncitizens were ineligible. The Secretary’s office asked the DHS for names, dates of birth, and addresses to confirm the matches.Washoe County [warned](https://us.list-manage.com/SXK2Py4aZEh?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) voters enrolled in ballot tracking that a Secretary of State vendor had sent them notices in error saying their mail ballots had gone out, when in-state ballots were not scheduled to mail until October 5.**New Jersey** The Ocean County Board of Elections [sent domicile questionnaires](https://us.list-manage.com/bDv0t1wvpa9?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) to about 37 Bay Head voters flagged by the local Republican chairman because their tax bills go to out-of-town addresses. The ACLU of New Jersey threatened to sue the board if it does not issue corrective notices confirming the active registration of the recipients. **North Carolina** The State Board of Elections [announced it would send letters](https://us.list-manage.com/pjfmHDWIK87?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) to 1,599 registrants flagged as potential noncitizens by the federal SAVE system, asking them to verify their citizenship or request removal if they registered by mistake. The State Board said no one will be removed automatically.**Pennsylvania** Bradford County [warned](https://us.list-manage.com/vpQhi33Uc40?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) that some voters’ mail ballots would arrive late because its printing vendor failed to mail ballot packets it had prepared the previous week.State lawmakers [proposed](https://us.list-manage.com/l4UpHyudHZe?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) HB 2758 to expressly extend Pennsylvania’s existing prohibition on police officers coming within 100 feet of a polling place to federal, state, and local law enforcement officers and agents, subject to existing exceptions for voting, serving a warrant, or responding to a request to preserve the peace. The bill would also allow individuals harmed by a convicted officer’s violation to seek damages and attorney fees.**South Dakota** Yankton County [resumed](https://us.list-manage.com/Rk1qwzsTQDd?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) absentee voting with corrected ballots after a week-long pause over a road and bridge levy question that read “referendum” where it should have read “resolution.” Voters who had already cast absentee ballots must vote again.**Tennessee** No candidate’s name will appear on the November ballot for the Memphis-area 93rd State House district. The late Rep. G.A. Hardaway, the only person to petition for either primary, [fell one signature short](https://us.list-manage.com/IlfuuK7zjPl?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) of the 25 valid signatures required.**Texas** The Secretary of State’s office [offered](https://us.list-manage.com/YMEInuh_5B5?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) counties reimbursement grants to process at least 200,000 online voter-registration applications and updates that the Department of Public Safety failed to transmit after an October 2025 vendor software update. The Texas Association of County Election Officials [attributed](https://us.list-manage.com/psv4yZTtTAp?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) continuing problems in the state’s voter registration system to “fundamental system architecture failures” by its vendor.The Texas Court of Criminal Appeals [declined](https://us.list-manage.com/18x0NYwK929?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) to reinstate Crystal Mason’s illegal-voting conviction, leaving in place the appellate acquittal that turned on whether prosecutors proved she knew she was ineligible.**Virginia** The Department of Elections [notified](https://us.list-manage.com/RxYBGLuKMlN?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) 234,852 people that their felony convictions should not have kept them from voting, after the state narrowed disqualifying felonies to murder and voluntary and involuntary manslaughter.Alex Nguyen [pleaded guilty](https://us.list-manage.com/15XSUDFQRIy?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) in federal court to impersonating an FBI agent at a Falls Church polling place during the November 2024 election, where he showed election officers a fake badge while carrying an air pistol.The Chesterfield County registrar [attributed](https://us.list-manage.com/eILYwmMG2eA?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) to human error the cancellation of a voter’s registration for a felony conviction she did not have, restored the registration, and began a procedures review with the State Board of Elections.**Wisconsin** A Green Bay man was [charged](https://us.list-manage.com/rSScnLVRwWw?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) with attempted election fraud for removing the security seal on the City Hall ballot drop box and pulling on its door. The city said no ballots were accessed.A Fond du Lac man was [sentenced](https://us.list-manage.com/1755xT2m8HR?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) to 30 days in jail for voting in the November 2020 election while on felony probation.

| | **Florida** Statewide Uniform Voter Registration ApplicationThe Division of Elections noticed development of [Rule 1S-2.040](https://us.list-manage.com/ImzwNHAtWcR?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a), Fla. Admin. Code, and its incorporated form DS-DE 39, under §§ 20.10, 97.012(1)–(2), and 97.052(1), Fla. Stat., to conform the statewide voter registration application to section 2 of chapter 2026-26, Laws of Florida. The rule is at the development stage, with no notice of proposed rule yet published.**Oregon** Procedure for Reporting Election ResultsAdopted (temporary): September 28, 2026, effective through March 19, 2027The Secretary of State [amended OAR 165-007-0550](https://us.list-manage.com/wv1ZiVG13W_?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) by temporary rule. The amendment allows counties to point the state’s unofficial-results website to county sites for ranked-choice contests, which the state system cannot display round by round. It also requires counties to report ballots with timely postmarks that arrived too late to be counted. The rule is adopted in temporary form.

| | **California** _**Cervantes v. Bianco**_**, No. S295866 (Cal.)** On September 24, the state Supreme Court [ordered](https://us.list-manage.com/XRU4ZEltpSg?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco to return the approximately 650,000 ballots his office seized from the registrar of voters under a search warrant, holding that the Elections Code bars removing ballots from an elections official’s custody notwithstanding a warrant._**Bonta v. Bianco**_**, No. S295901 (Cal.)** On September 24, in a companion case, the state Supreme Court [held](https://us.list-manage.com/BbzrT9B9nTj?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) that the Attorney General may issue binding directions to sheriffs in criminal investigations and that Sheriff Bianco acted unlawfully in disregarding the Attorney General’s March directive to halt execution of the warrant._**California Council of the Blind v. Weber**_**,** **No. 3:24-cv-01447 (N.D. Cal.)** On October 2, a federal court [ruled](https://us.list-manage.com/178aQN14w_y?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) that California’s vote-by-mail program denies voters with print disabilities meaningful access by requiring them to print, sign, and return paper ballots after marking them electronically, and directed the Secretary of State to propose a revised protocol by October 19.**District of Columbia** _**League of Women Voters v. U.S. Department of Homeland Security**_**, No. 1:25-cv-03501 (D.D.C.)** On September 25, the U.S. Supreme Court [stayed](https://us.list-manage.com/19uAuG9OHim?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) a federal court’s injunction against the Department of Homeland Security’s expanded SAVE citizenship-verification system, allowing the DHS to resume using it pending appeal._**Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County v. U.S. Department of Homeland Security**_**, No. 1:26-cv-02886 (D.D.C.)** On September 28, a federal court [held](https://us.list-manage.com/TDlxwRKswfU?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) that FEMA lacked authority to condition Homeland Security counterterrorism grants on election-administration requirements, including citizenship verification of all registered voters and plans to move from barcode-tabulated ballots to hand-marked paper ballots._**Democratic National Committee v. U.S. Department of Defense**_**,** **No. 1:26-cv-03431 (D.D.C.)** On October 1, the Democratic National Committee [filed suit](https://us.list-manage.com/z0AYqWOzCIP?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) in federal court against the Defense Department and the Office of Management and Budget over its revision of the Federal Post Card Application, which removed the checkbox for U.S. citizens abroad who have never lived in the United States. The DNC claims the change violated the Administrative Procedure Act.**Florida** _**United States v. Cox**_**,** **No. 0:25-cr-60249 (S.D. Fla.)** On October 1, a federal court [dismissed](https://us.list-manage.com/2OCEcWDx4RM?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) a charge against a Jamaican national accused of voting in the 2020 election, holding that Congress lacked constitutional authority to enact the federal ban on noncitizen voting because voter qualifications are set by the states._**Florida Rising Together, Inc. v. Byrd**_ , **No. 6:24-cv-01682 (M.D. Fla.)** On September 29, a federal court [dismissed](https://us.list-manage.com/5TNvhRjfiBb?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) for lack of standing a challenge to Florida’s requirement that registration applicants whose driver’s license or Social Security numbers do not match state records verify their identity. The court gave the plaintiffs until October 15 to amend.**Georgia** _**United States v. Raffensperger**_**,** **No. 1:26-cv-00485 (N.D. Ga.)** On September 30, a federal court [dismissed](https://us.list-manage.com/EAwJY0aq0wX?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) the Justice Department’s suit for Georgia’s unredacted voter file, holding that Title III of the Civil Rights Act, the National Voter Registration Act, and the Help America Vote Act do not preempt Georgia’s voter privacy law._**Republican National Committee v. Allen**_**, No. 26CV008750 (Ga. Super. Ct., Fulton Cnty.)** On October 1, a state court [dismissed](https://us.list-manage.com/qGiHWjgU8hV?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) as moot a suit by the Republican National Committee, the Fulton County Republican Party, and secretary of state candidate Tim Fleming challenging a Fulton County policy that let voters return absentee ballots at 22 advance voting sites, because the county board ended the policy in May.**Louisiana** _**League of Women Voters of Louisiana v. Landry**_**, No. 3:25-cv-00413 (M.D. La.)** On September 29, a federal court [granted in part](https://us.list-manage.com/fx_P4xobS4B?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) Louisiana officials’ motion to dismiss a challenge to Act 500, the state’s documentary proof-of-citizenship requirement for voter registration. The court dismissed the National Voter Registration Act claims without prejudice for deficient pre-suit notice but allowed vagueness and equal protection claims to proceed.**Maryland** _**Electronic Privacy Information Center v. U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services**_**, No. 8:26-cv-03457 (D. Md.)** The Electronic Privacy Information Center (EPIC) [challenged](https://us.list-manage.com/1353HW3Wtou?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) a federal initiative to compile and provide state election officials with state-specific lists of adult U.S. citizens, alleging violations of the Privacy Act, Social Security Act, Administrative Procedure Act, and constitutional limits on executive branch authority over elections.**Missouri** _**Onder v. State of Missouri**_**, No. 4:26-cv-01424 (E.D. Mo.)** On September 25, the U.S. Supreme Court [stayed](https://us.list-manage.com/tRfGPBIALfY?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) the Eighth Circuit’s mandate and order and the federal court’s September 21 and 22 injunctions, directing that no court bar use of the 2022 congressional map or require use of the 2025 map in the 2026 election.**Montana** _**Disability Rights Montana v. Jacobsen**_**,** **No. ADV-2025-293 (Mont. Dist. Ct., Lewis & Clark Cnty.)**On October 5, a state court [struck down](https://us.list-manage.com/epyr8D4x7Ty?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) HB 719’s requirement that voters write their birth year on absentee ballot return envelopes as a violation of the Montana Constitution. As a result, general election ballots missing the birth year will not be rejected.**New Hampshire** _**Coalition for Open Democracy v. clean_body: Florida Takes Its Election Playbook National | | | | | | | | | Florida Takes Its Election Playbook NationalBy Justin Riemer, President, USGI Florida Governor Ron DeSantis and Secretary of State Cord Byrd want other states to copy Florida’s election policies. On September 24, DeSantis and Byrd the Association of State and Local Election Officials (ASLEO), a new organization that will train election administrators and promote policies based on Florida’s approach. Byrd, who plans to lead the group after November’s election, said, “We want to take the Florida blueprint and take it nationwide.” The announcement was made in conjunction with news that state prosecutors had indicted 20 individuals for election crimes, most of whom are noncitizens charged with registering and voting illegally. The governor highlighted various Florida policies as a blueprint ASLEO will work to enact outside the state, particularly those that speed up ballot counting. The governor also highlighted the state’s Office of Election Crimes and Security, an dedicated to investigating fraud and irregularities in coordination with state prosecutors and its efforts to rein in ballot petition fraud. The latest indictments bring the office’s total to more than 100 arrests and prosecutions since its creation in 2022. It remains to be seen the extent to which ASLEO will compete with organizations like the National Association of State Election Directors (NASED) and the Election Center that offer training and credentialing or just primarily focus on lobbying and policy advocacy. Regarding policy, ASLEO has a compelling story to tell about how Florida transformed its elections in the last quarter-century since its embarrassing time under the microscope in the 2000 recount. Lack of clear and uniform ballot counting and recount standards, problems with ballot design and voting systems, and local election official incompetence dominated headlines for years, but Florida eventually started figuring things out. Now, even critics of Florida’s efforts to tighten its voting processes must at least begrudgingly acknowledge its emergence as a national leader in mastering the nuts and bolts of election administration and the professionalism of its election officials. Even setting aside disputed list maintenance, proof of citizenship, or voter ID policies, Florida sets the standard for efficient ballot counting, leaving even the New York Times to note that “Florida Counts Its Election Ballots Fast,” and asking, “Why Can’t California Keep Up?” Despite ranking third in state population and spanning two time zones, Florida reports its results faster than any other state, thanks to its Election Day ballot receipt deadline, generous pre-election processing allowances, and statutory deadlines for completing the count. In the 2024 General Election, Florida had of its vote by about 8 p.m. Eastern when the AP called the race, roughly an hour after polls closed across most of the state. California, by contrast, took nearly a month to finish counting its 2024 general election ballots. Good policy only means so much if you don’t have effective administrators to implement it. And even as the legislature hammered away at fixing pervasive weaknesses in state election law, Florida was still held back by pockets of incompetent local election administration, particularly in and counties. So the state stepped in: Governor Rick Scott suspended Broward Supervisor of Elections Brenda Snipes in 2018, and Governor DeSantis suspended Palm Beach Supervisor Susan Bucher in 2019, sidelining the officials in those continuously poor performing counties. And even though Florida’s county Supervisors of Elections are elected, voters have generally chosen competent, serious administrators. Whether progressive states like California, Illinois, or New York will be receptive to ASLEO outreach remains to be seen. But it could be impactful by directing its efforts in those types of states to less controversial reforms including those that would speed up ballot counting. As far as more contentious policy changes, Florida has been sued as much as any state over its election reforms, but those challenges have been largely unsuccessful. For those states looking to model Florida policy on absentee voting verification, registration safeguards, and others, ASLEO can offer them a battle-tested blueprint. It’s also important to note that Florida has improved its elections and tightened its processes while keeping voting easy. It continues to offer no-excuse absentee voting, a generous early voting period, and smooth Election Day voting all while delivering quick, accurate, and trustworthy election results. U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services, No. 8:26-cv-03457 (D. Md.) The Electronic Privacy Information Center (EPIC) a federal initiative to compile and provide state election officials with state-specific lists of adult U.S. citizens, alleging violations of the Privacy Act, Social Security Act, Administrative Procedure Act, and constitutional limits on executive branch authority over elections.Missouri Onder v. State of Missouri, No. 4:26-cv-01424 (E.D. Mo.) On September 25, the U.S. Supreme Court the Eighth Circuit’s mandate and order and the federal court’s September 21 and 22 injunctions, directing that no court bar use of the 2022 congressional map or require use of the 2025 map in the 2026 election.Montana Disability Rights Montana v. Jacobsen, No. ADV-2025-293 (Mont. Dist. Ct., Lewis & Clark Cnty.)On October 5, a state court HB 719’s requirement that voters write their birth year on absentee ballot return envelopes as a violation of the Montana Constitution. On October 2, a federal court Secretary of State David Scanlan’s April directive to the extent it bars election officials from considering student IDs as evidence of identity under the voter ID law’s safety-valve provision. The court declined to block HB 323’s removal of student IDs from the list of accepted IDs.Ohio Red Wine & Blue v. LaRose, No. 1:25-cv-01760 (N.D. Ohio) On September 23, the Sixth Circuit a federal court’s preliminary injunction against Ohio’s requirement that people registering to vote at motor vehicle offices show documentary proof of citizenship, finding the challengers likely lacked standing and the injunction came too close to the election.South Carolina NAACP South Carolina State Conference v. Wilson, No. 3:25-cv-13754 (D.S.C.) On September 30, a federal court without prejudice the NAACP South Carolina State Conference’s challenge to state limits on who may assist voters with absentee ballots and how many absentee applications and return envelopes one person may handle, holding that the plaintiffs lacked standing.Tennessee Reeves v. Grandy, No. 26-CV-0405 (Tenn. Ch. Ct., Washington Cnty.) On September 30, a state court a defeated candidate’s contest of the August 6 Washington County mayoral election and denied his request to inspect voting machines, holding that the complaint did not allege fraud or illegality with enough specificity. The ruling freed the machines for use in November.Texas Peoples v. Tarrant County, No. 096-384401-26 (Tex. Dist. Ct., Tarrant Cnty.) On October 2, four Tarrant County voters, including Fort Worth City Council member Deborah Peoples, County Judge Tim O’Hare, the two other Republican commissioners, and the county elections administrator in state court to restore 92 Election Day polling sites dropped from the 2022 list. They allege that the cuts intentionally and disproportionately burden minority voters and seek an injunction before early voting begins October 19.Washington Soto Palmer v. Hobbs , No. 3:22-cv-05035 (W.D. Wash.); Garcia v. Hobbs , No. 3:22-cv-05152 (W.D. Wash.) On October 5, the U.S. Supreme Court the Ninth Circuit’s judgments in the Section 2 Voting Rights Act and Equal Protection Clause challenges to Washington’s Yakima Valley legislative district and remanded both for further consideration in light of Louisiana v. Callais.Wyoming Malcom v. Gray, No. S-26-0029 (Wyo.) On October 1, the state Supreme Court a ruling upholding the state’s requirement that voters declare or change party affiliation at least 96 days before a primary, holding that the deadline imposes only a slight burden and does not violate the state constitution’s election or equal protection guarantees.International On October 5, the Supreme Court of India the national government and the Election Commission of India to respond to petitions challenging the commission’s special intensive revision of voter rolls. The commission says the revision targets fraudulent and noncitizen registrations, while opposition parties say it improperly removed millions of names. | | | The Justice Department charges or guilty pleas against 12 people in Florida, Hawaii, Kansas, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Texas, and Utah. Eleven are noncitizens accused of illegal voting or fraudulent registration, and the twelfth is a former Utah letter carrier accused of discarding about 300 mail ballots. The DOJ subsequently charges against 16 lawful permanent residents in Florida, Louisiana, Minnesota, and Wisconsin for voting as noncitizens, falsely claiming citizenship to register or vote, or related offenses, most of them tied to the 2024 general election. | | | The Senate 53–47 on the House-passed Stop Insider Trading Act, short of the 60 votes needed to advance it, after Democrats objected to a provision requiring photo identification to vote in federal elections.The Department of Homeland Security that states must meet unspecified new election-security requirements before receiving their full Homeland Security Grant Program awards, two days after a federal court struck the department’s earlier election conditions from the counterterrorism grants.The U.S. Postal Service a memo directing extended retail hours, dedicated ballot-postmark lines, expedited handling, and extra pickups of ballot mail through the November 3 election.The Census Bureau residence criteria for the 2030 census that would count citizens and lawful permanent residents in the apportionment base while excluding noncitizens without lawful status and those whose status is less durable than permanent residence. It also proposed a new rule restricting race and other demographic questions on the short-form questionnaire. The revisions removed the checkbox used since 2013 by overseas citizens who have never lived in the United States. Thirty-six years ago, my wife, LaVon, and I built a congregation that brings people from all walks of life — Democrats, Republicans and Independents — together to live out their faith in service to one another.
I’ve never run for office before, but when I saw how our leaders in Washington were making life harder for my neighbors, I felt called to step up.
**I’m running for U.S. Senate to lower costs, stop the chaos and corruption in Washington and make sure folks have access to the healthcare they need. could be whatever you wanted to be.

stories of the most important and difficult times in our nation’s history.

Right now, Michigan and our country are in one of those critical times.
Our democracy is under attack, and we all have to stand up and do our part
to protect it.

departments in Detroit and Wayne County to get glasses to kids who need

But that means he’s being massively outspent by Republicans, so he’s

You can help us make history,
Peter.

Team, Since you opened this email and are taking the time to read it, you're different from most people. Let us explain. Most people don't have time to engage with politics. We get why--life has become so unaffordable that people need to work harder and harder to get by. That's why Pat works so hard fighting for the Hudson Valley. **Just by opening this email, you're among the most politically engaged people in the country.** You're different. You likely already know how you're voting and who you're voting for. But the people who will decide this election are just tuning in now. That's why we need to work hard mobilizing people throughout the Hudson Valley and around the country to flip the House and repudiate MAGA on November 3. So we need your help. **First:** We need you to think of 10 family members or friends who may not be voting or may not be voting for Democrats. Five years of media silence about COVID vaccine injuries broke this month -- not on cable news, not at the networks, but in a tabloid column in Toronto and an open letter signed by 168 physicians, scientists, lawmakers, and public figures. Ten days. Two prongs of the same offensive. And suddenly the "safe and effective" press consensus is negotiable.
**What the silence looked like**
For five years, asking questions about vaccine injury got Canadians fired from their jobs, barred from flights and restaurants, and -- under the Emergencies Act -- locked out of their bank accounts. In the press, it got you called a conspiracy theorist. Every major outlet ran the official line. Including the Toronto Sun itself.
Then Conservative MP Dean Allison did what no government would: he held hearings anyway. Fifty witnesses, the first inquiry of its kind in Canada. Senator Ron Johnson opened it. Dr. Peter McCullough closed it. Dan Hartman told the country how his son Sean -- 17 years old, a hockey player -- died in 2021.

name: Nick Shirley
subject: Newsom signed a law to stop me
body:
The dubbed “Stop Nick Shirley Act” was made to stop me.

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e872910/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvbnpzNjJVQTNzRg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjEwMDg/LbmNsMURvaDRabQ/qP2hpZHM9bmNsNEdGOUxlYzZRQXZscw/gaseZ0A/s1r1824e217)
| | | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | |
# Friend,
---
There's now a law in California with my name associated with it. Everyone in Sacramento knows exactly what the **"Stop Nick Shirley Act"** means. On August 22nd, Governor Newsom signed AB 2624. Three days later, I was standing at the State Capitol with a crowd of people who showed up because they understood what this law _actually_ does.
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Supporters say it protects immigration workers from harassment. Here's what it really does, Friend: **it makes it harder for anyone — me included — to investigate where your tax dollars are being sent.** I said it plainly at the rally: this is not the end; _this is just the beginning._ Because here's the part that should bother you more than anything else. **The assemblymember who wrote this bill is married to California's Attorney General** — the _one person_ in this state whose entire job is supposed to be going after fraud. Instead, his wife wrote the bill that makes it harder to expose it. That's not a coincidence, Friend. That's the system protecting itself. **[Friend, will you make a tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, or $100 today to help keep independent journalists like me in the field?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**
---
[ **Yes —****I'll****Help Keep Independent Journalists in the Field** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
I've spent the last year showing up where legacy media won't — daycare centers, tax-funded nonprofits, the offices of people who'd rather I disappear than answer a question. That work is exactly why a state legislature decided to write a law with my name on it instead of going after the fraud I keep finding. A state senator at the rally called it unconstitutional. A city attorney called it a direct threat to the First Amendment. _They're right_ — and they're not going to be the ones who stop it. That's going to take people willing to fund the reporters still asking the questions. Here's something most people don't see, Friend: doing this work independently means there's no network paying for the flight to Sacramento, no legal department covering me if a state files a complaint over a story, no corporate budget for the cameras and editors it takes to get this footage in front of you. When I showed up at that rally, **Lincoln Media Foundation** was on site with their own journalists to cover it, because they understood what was actually at stake before most of the country did. _That’s why I’m partnering with Lincoln Media Foundation._ They understand how important it is to support independent journalists and help us keep doing the work without compromising what makes it independent in the _first place._ I’m grateful for their partnership and commitment, and **[every dollar you give to LMF goes directly toward keeping reporters like me in the field](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** – helping cover travel, equipment, and the costs that come with confronting people on camera instead of reading a press release about them.

**Since LMF is a 501(c)3, your gift is tax-deductible** , and it can be made anonymously if that's what you'd prefer.
---
[ **Yes —****I'll****Fund Independent Investigations** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Friend, they can pass all the laws they want. They can try to prevent people like me from exposing their corruption, that’s why it crucial to support independent journalists like myself. They are creating laws to silence free speech — and that’s why we need to continue the fight and I need your support. People like you decide this work is worth funding, and it helps me continue! **[Will you help LMF keep me — and journalists like me — in the field with a gift of $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can give today?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**
---
For the truth,

_**Nick Shirley**_
---
[ **Help Support Nick’s Work** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
P.S. — A California assemblyman is already asking the DOJ to intervene against this law. That tells you how serious this is. **[A tax-deductible gift today helps LMF keep me and other independent journalists in the field while this fight plays out.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**

name: Tyler Bowyer, Turning Point Action
subject: Here's what's really on the line...
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TURNING POINT ACTION (TPACTION
body:
Three states are about to decide a lot more than 2026.

| | | |
---
Peter,
---
We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let me explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

clean_body: This may be the most important message you read today. | | | Peter, I’m going to be straight with you: This may be the most important message you read today. That’s exactly where Mike Rogers is right now. Mike is an Army veteran and former Congressman who came within 0.3% of winning his Senate race in 2024. He’s already faced the toughest attacks the Left could throw at him, and came incredibly close before. With the right support, Make no mistake: if we lose this seat, Democrats WILL take control of the Senate. He’s an Army veteran who stands for our values, and he’s ready to fight like hell to keep the Senate Majority in Republican hands because America is worth fighting for. But he can’t do it alone, Peter. Democrats are pouring MILLIONS into this race. It’s now one of the most expensive and closely watched races in the country. . subject: Patriot, I’m asking you to stand beside me
body:
What happened to me in the pool was only the beginning of my fight.

View in Web Browser
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.com/click/e5932214/UaHR0cHM6Ly9vZGIubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvUERteldSNjIyNg/SZW1haWxfZnJlZXRoaW5rZXJkYWlseV9jb20yNjEwMDg/LbmNsbnprdXE0NQ/qP2hpZHM9bmNSdmF1NkVQSXZaZ3Fsc10/gasehBw/saq06a7bbf0

[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

Dear Patriot,

Even though we don’t know each other yet, I’m writing to ask you
to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.

Actually, in my case, it’s a slippery slide.

Because my name is Riley Gaines and I’m the University of Kentucky
swimmer who had to compete against a fully intact 6’4” male
swimmer dressed in a women’s bathing suit.

And after he stole the victory I had worked for my entire life, I had
to go back to the women’s locker room and undress out of my wet
bathing suit while he did the same next to me.

Maybe you want to stop reading right now.

I know the images I’m bringing up are horrible.

But please don’t stop.

Because God-fearing, faith-filled people like you and me have a job to
do today.

We can’t retreat into our homes and hope President Trump will fix
everything and the Left’s evil culture will just pass us by.

That’s why I’m asking you to give in the next 48 hours.

My fellow conservative, you know this slippery slide.

It’s the same one you got pushed down when the Left told you
abortion was going to be “safe, legal, and rare.” Now abortion is
a “right” and “women’s healthcare.” And if you don’t
support it up until the moment of birth, you must “hate women.”

It’s the same slippery slide you got pushed down when the Left told
you limiting gay couples to civil unions was “mean.” You were
told, “They just want to use the word “marriage” like everyone
else. It’s just a word.” Now if you don’t fully embrace the
homosexual lifestyle by displaying rainbows and celebrating gay pride,
you’re a “hate-filled bigot.”

Enough with their lies. We have Truth on our side. And we need to
start acting like it.

God created man. And God created woman.

It isn’t any more complicated than that.

Letting men believe they are women... letting girls believe they are
boys... is a bold-faced rejection of God’s truth.

President Trump is fighting these lies with temporary Executive
Orders. But radical courts are already undermining him. We must stop
this deranged movement from gaining one more inch.

We’ve got to counter them in the courts or rogue judges will rule
that kids can be taken away from parents who oppose this evil... that
schools can hide “transition” from parents... and that doctors can
mutilate children with no consequences.

Your chance is right now – and right by my side.

Please stand with me against the radical transgender movement by
making a gift in the next 48 hours.

YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

Please don’t tell me, “Riley, this isn’t a widespread
problem.”

Look at this photo.

[Lavine and Brinton]
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

This is pediatrician, 4-star admiral, and former Assistant Secretary
for Health -- Rachel Levine (born Richard Levine). This man in a
women’s Navy uniform has been a “leader” in your government.

And the person standing next to Levine? That’s Sam Brinton. He’s a
man in a dress who was a Biden-Harris nuclear official until he got
caught stealing luggage at Ronald Reagan Airport filled with ladies
clothes.

Then consider that 11 states and counting, plus the District of
Columbia, are transgender “sanctuary” states. That means in some
of them, minor children can flee there and get transgender services --
even sex change operations -- without their parents’ permission.

And did you know Medicare now covers sex change operations?

It just goes on and on... This evil is widespread.

Or maybe you’re thinking like so many, “Riley, adults are free to
do whatever they want. And children should be kept away from this evil
by their parents.”

As for the transgender adults, your generation used to call these
people perverts, predators, and pedophiles.

Should they be representing our government? Alone in classrooms with
our children?

And as for parents, I agree this problem would have less traction if
parents just said, “No.”

But parents in Maryland had their child taken away because they
refused to let their son transition to a “girl.”

Parents in states like Vermont and Colorado saw their foster care
licenses revoked because they admitted they would not help a child who
may be assigned to their home get puberty blockers or have sex change
surgery.

Parents in California got themselves elected to the school board,
passed guidelines to protect their children from the transgender
movement, and now the state of California is suing them.

Even with President Trump’s temporary Executive Orders attempting to
ban men from women’s sports and bathrooms, and halt grotesque
medical procedures for children... you can see, the radical
transgender movement has parents backed into a corner.

I’m sorry I’ve gone on so long detailing the transgender threat.
But when I’m speaking around the country, I meet so many seniors who
say, “I wish someone had told me about this sooner.”

But the good news is that right now, you still have a chance to help
stop the radical transgender movement before they push us down their
slippery slide.

And today I’m writing you on behalf of a group that is doing more
work to block the transgender movement than anyone I know.

It’s the legal non-profit the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY.

YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

And your gift is going straight to help them.

With the help of patriots like you, the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY
fights the transgender movement in the courts because that’s the
only way to stop them.

And the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY is attacking this evil from all
sides with their comprehensive three-pronged approach.

#1. THEY’RE FIGHTING RADICAL SCHOOLS.

I know it may sound crazy to you but in today’s taxpayer-funded
schools, teachers, and counselors encourage young children to socially
“transition” at school and then facilitate the “transition” by
giving children new names and even giving them new clothes so they can
dress as the opposite sex.

And they keep it all a secret from parents!

You probably remember a time when kids needed a note from home just to
get an aspirin at school!

The CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY is taking these radicals to court in
multiple cases. And they already have one major win!

When you give, you’re making sure PARENTS have the final word in
guiding their children -- not school radicals!

#2. THEY’RE FIGHTING RADICAL DOCTORS.

My fellow conservative, I hope you love and trust your doctors. There
are lots of good ones out there.

But there are also doctors who mutilate children for profit in the
name of transgender “care.” They use their “expertise” to
convince even conservative parents that if they oppose
“transition,” their child will commit suicide.

Then these doctors pump children full of dangerous puberty blockers
and perform gruesome surgeries to remove children’s healthy breasts
and other parts.

Again, I apologize for the graphic description, but this is the pure
evil we’re facing.

Maybe you’ve seen a girl named Chloe Cole on Fox News. In a landmark
case, the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY is helping her sue the radical
doctors and hospital that gave her a double mastectomy at age 15.

President Trump signed an Executive Order aimed at protecting children
from these grotesque doctors but a Biden-appointed federal judge has
already blocked its enforcement.

The best way to protect children is to contribute to help Chloe and
the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY win their case to make sure this never
happens to another child!

#3. THEY’RE FIGHTING FOR YOUR RIGHT TO SPEAK OUT AGAINST THIS
HEINOUS EVIL.

You’ll be happy to know that fighting for Freedom of Speech is one
of the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY’S specialties.

They’ve notched plenty of victories in this space including fighting
for an 82-year-old grandmother who got banned for life from the YMCA.

This grandma raised the alarm that a grown man dressed in a women’s
bathing suit was in the women’s locker room “helping” two little
girls get ready to use the bathroom.

And she was the one punished!

But thanks to supporters just like you, the CENTER FOR AMERICAN
LIBERTY fought back and won! And when you give, you’re helping them
win all their critical cases confronting the evil of the transgender
movement.

YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

I know you’d probably love to fund an entire court case on your own
after all I’ve told you, but all I’m asking you to do is RENEW
YOUR SUPPORT with a tax-deductible gift of $30, $50, $75, $100 or even
$250 or more.

Please donate whatever amount is right for you whether it’s smaller
or larger. The CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY needs and appreciates
every dollar that comes in.

And because I believe so strongly in the work they’re doing – and
because they are one of the few groups who’ve stood
shoulder-to-shoulder with me in this fight...

It will be my honor to send you my new book “Swimming Against the
Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That’s Lost Its
Mind” as my free gift when you donate $50 or more to the CENTER FOR
AMERICAN LIBERTY.

[Lavine and Brinton]
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

Before I go, please let me share one last thought with you.

Every morning as a competitive swimmer, I would get up and think of
this verse:

_For I consider that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy
to be compared to the glory that is about to be revealed to us._
(Romans 8:18)

I applied it to my swimming: work hard now and wins come later. But
now I see that God has a much bigger plan for my life just as He does
for yours.

This battle isn’t about a swimming victory. It’s about Kingdom
victory. I will never stop fighting to protect God’s Truth and I
think you feel the same way.

Thank you for reading my letter all the way to the end. I’m praying
for you, and I hope you’ll pray for me too.

Sincerely,

Riley Gaines

P.S. I’m so grateful that President Trump signed temporary Executive
Orders aimed at stopping the radical transgender movement. But the
Left is launching attacks in the courts to undermine him and we must
fight back.

God made man and God made woman. The attempts to deny those basic
truths, are attempts to deny the truth of God.

Your help is so critical to the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY’S work,
when you donate $50 or more, as my personal “Thank You,” I’ll
send you my new book, “Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for
Common Sense in a World That’s Lost Its Mind” for free. Please
hurry. It’s getting hard to hold back this evil without you. I
don’t want you to look back a year from now and say, “I wish I had
done something when I had the chance.”

SUPPORT CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

The Center for American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit charitable
organization fighting against growing anti-free speech and anti-civil
liberties trends. Your gift is tax-deductible.

Center for American Liberty
PO Box 200942
Pittsburgh, PA 15251-0942

This email was sent to DPWILLIS67@GMAIL.COM as part of your
subscription to FREE THINKER DAILY

108 S Washington St. Suite 200
Alexandria, VA 22314

This battle isn’t about a swimming victory. It’s about Kingdom victory. I will never stop fighting to protect God’s Truth and I think you feel the same way. Thank you for reading my letter all the way to the end. I’m praying for you, and I hope you’ll pray for me too. Sincerely, Riley Gaines P.S. I’m so grateful that President Trump signed temporary Executive Orders aimed at stopping the radical transgender movement. But the Left is launching attacks in the courts to undermine him and we must fight back. God made man and God made woman. The attempts to deny those basic truths, are attempts to deny the truth of God. Your help is so critical to the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY’S work, when you donate $50 or more, as my personal “Thank You,” I’ll send you my new book, “Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That’s Lost Its Mind” for free. Please hurry. It’s getting hard to hold back this evil without you. I don’t want you to look back a year from now and say, “I wish I had done something when I had the chance.” SUPPORT CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY [ The Center for American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit charitable organization fighting against growing anti-free speech and anti-civil liberties trends. subject: “Threatens to return the country to a pre-1965 America”

body:
We’re up against more efforts to silence Black voters and make voting as burdensome as possible |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140947877/652035220/-901897163?refcode=emm_ff_20261008_DirectMail_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMmM2ODRjZi0yMWMzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VPgKMaoTQHkZhMJt2cls-s-6Vf7ra11_2Si1YGnx2no=&emci=564a4308-a6c2-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&emdi=d2c684cf-21c3-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&ceid=1037277)

| | | **“WHITES ONLY”**
“The Supreme Court’s decision...**threatens to return the country to a pre-1965 America,** when white supremacy was the law of the land and Congress contained no Black members from the South.”
_—Mother Jones_
---
**Throughout the years, there has been one throughline in our work at Fair Fight — voter access.**
Creating a world in which each and every eligible American has the freedom to register to vote, cast their ballot, and have that ballot counted fairly — and that they had the information, safety, and comfort that they needed to show up to vote.
That is the driving force behind everything we do.
**Over the last few months, there have been more and more efforts to make voting as burdensome as possible across the South. **
And ever since the Supreme Court gutted Section 2 of the _Voting Rights Act_ in April, Southern states have drawn new racist voting maps that erase hard-won representation for Black Americans.
Republicans have been fighting tooth and nail to suppress the Black vote. They use racially-neutral language to try to hide their brutally racist actions. You know what that’s called? RACISM.

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

name: Troy Jackson
subject: We can’t eat road salt
body:
| | | |
---
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140949413/652040528/2104604413?refcode=261008_jackson_postdebate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzA5NGRiZC0yM2MzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Zwzhd5A_ryZAnCmzIgmT8ofAtnAA3uy9Wmm-s3-DvQ8=)
---
Susan Collins really knows how to put on a show in the Senate. She votes with Trump 96% of the time. If she knows one of his bad bills is going to tank, she’ll vote against it. If she’s the deciding vote, she’ll always vote for it, just like how she was the deciding vote for Brett Kavanaugh, who then overturned Roe v. Wade. The same is also true with Trump’s tariffs. Mainers and folks across the country are hurting badly from rising costs – and too many families are having to pick between picking up their prescriptions or putting food on the table. So when she said during our debate that she brought down the cost of road salt, I had to say what shouldn’t need to be said:
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140949414/652040530/-685884716?refcode=261008_jackson_postdebate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzA5NGRiZC0yM2MzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Zwzhd5A_ryZAnCmzIgmT8ofAtnAA3uy9Wmm-s3-DvQ8=)
---
It goes to show just how out of touch Susan is with families across Maine. Road salt isn’t going to make groceries, heating oil, or everyday necessities affordable again. Susan Collins is so used to putting the needs of billionaires over her constituents. I’m running to defeat her because folks across Maine have made me into the public servant I am today, and they deserve a Senator who isn’t afraid to take on tough battles. But poll after poll shows me tied with Susan Collins, and she’s spending double what we are on TV ads. We need to pick up the pace if we want any shot at flipping this seat and retaking the Senate majority for Democrats. **[So will you please split $15 – or more, if you can spare it – between my campaign and Equal Opportunity Now right away? I refuse to take a dime from corporate PACs (unlike Susan), so I can’t run my campaign without folks like you chipping in.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140949415/652040531/-685884716?refcode=261008_jackson_postdebate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzA5NGRiZC0yM2MzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Zwzhd5A_ryZAnCmzIgmT8ofAtnAA3uy9Wmm-s3-DvQ8=)**

body:
Let me explain.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q42026.PjNIJI&refcode=em261008-1-b&t=1&akid=11904%2E3935704%2EemhDvl)
---
Friends,
It’s Gabby Giffords, and I made a difficult decision that I have to share with you.
We just wrapped up our GIFFORDS all-staff meeting where it was clear that if we had more money in our budget, we could make another play to reach persuadable voters for the midterm elections.
We didn’t have the money yet, but I approved the plan anyway. Let me explain why.
We are officially in the final stretch of the election. Ballots are arriving in mailboxes, and early voting is starting soon. With polls statistically tied, reaching even 1,000 more voters right now could mean the difference between winning and losing the most competitive of races.
So, after a lot of discussion, I gave the green light to expand our voter outreach.
It is a risky decision. But if we want to overcome the attacks from the gun lobby and take back a gun safety majority, then we need to take big risks right now before it’s too late.
I made this decision because I know the strength of this grassroots team. Now, I’m hoping you can help us fill our $12,000 budget gap and get the resources to win this election.
**[So please, will you chip in to GIFFORDS PAC before the clock strikes midnight? We have an incredible slate of gun sense champions on the ballot, but it’ll take all of us to get them into office.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q42026.PjNIJI&refcode=em261008-1-b&t=2&akid=11904%2E3935704%2EemhDvl)

clean_body: Let me explain. Friends, It’s Gabby Giffords, and I made a difficult decision that I have to share with you. We just wrapped up our GIFFORDS all-staff meeting where it was clear that if we had more money in our budget, we could make another play to reach persuadable voters for the midterm elections. We didn’t have the money yet, but I approved the plan anyway. Let me explain why. We are officially in the final stretch of the election. Ballots are arriving in mailboxes, and early voting is starting soon. With polls statistically tied, reaching even 1,000 more voters right now could mean the difference between winning and losing the most competitive of races. So, after a lot of discussion, I gave the green light to expand our voter outreach. It is a risky decision. But if we want to overcome the attacks from the gun lobby and take back a gun safety majority, then we need to take big risks right now before it’s too late. I made this decision because I know the strength of this grassroots team. Now, I’m hoping you can help us fill our $12,000 budget gap and get the resources to win this election. A steady gaze is more than looking; it is the discipline of seeing what is before us and wondering what brought it here.
The sag of a weathered gate, weakening boards, a fence line straining against itself.
A sentinel begins not with conclusions, but with inquiry:
What happened here?
What has changed?
What if we leave it?
The gaze follows the evidence--from what shaped it to what our choices will set in motion.
**Observation is the first act of stewardship.**
**We cannot protect what we refuse to observe.**
**Stewardship is the courage to look closely and act.**
Pause.
Breathe.
Look Deeper.
Refuel.
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.**

---
| | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
__Two Indianapolis TV Stations Offer to Host Debates__ **October 8, 2026** **WESTFIELD, IN** - Congresswoman Victoria Spartz (IN-05) is challenging her Democratic opponent, State Senator J.D. Ford, to participate in a real policy debate, not a staged rally with his activists. The Spartz campaign has been working with the debate commission and local television stations to arrange a substantive debate. Two stations have offered to host:
* WTHR: October 19 or 20
* FOX59/CBS4: October 23 or 30

Spartz is ready to participate under either station’s proposed format and welcomes constituents from both sides in the audience if the stations can accommodate them. “Hoosiers deserve a serious policy debate, not another circus of nonstop screaming, shouting, jumping on tables, and spitting at my staff, as we have experienced at some town halls,” said Spartz. “A debate should be about answering tough questions, not who can shout the loudest.” “Since J.D. Ford just recently moved to Indiana’s 5th District from Marion County, he might not realize that you don’t usually run to get elected here on defunding the police, violent criminals on the streets, men in girls’ sports, transgender surgery for children, higher taxes, taxpayer benefits for illegals, and loopholes for special interests to fund his campaign. Or maybe he does realize that, and that’s why he is avoiding a real debate while radical San Francisco billionaires spend millions attacking me with fabricated lies.” “I am ready to defend every vote I have taken and answer tough questions about my record. J.D. Ford should be prepared to do the same and substantiate his accusations against me. Two television stations have offered to host. I am ready for either—or both. Why is J.D. hiding?”

This is a once in a century opportunity
#

Peter, look at this from _Politico,_ and let me explain why it matters.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-hamilton.mp3doH&refcode=em261010-1-90&t=1&akid=4221%2E734936%2E1kjXGb)
**The good news first:** Republicans are terrified that Adam Hamilton, a 5th generation Kansan, preacher of 36 years, and a _Democrat_ is going to win in Kansas.
This reporting came out because in a year when Republicans are holding on by a thread in North Carolina, Texas, and Alaska, they’re quietly sending $8 million dollars to a state Democrats haven’t won in 93 years.
**The bad news:** Outside of Kansas, Adam Hamilton’s race is flying under the radar. We all need to step up if he’s going to fight back against this spending from the national Republican party.
[**So I’m asking you to split $5 between us.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-hamilton.mp3doH&refcode=em261010-1-90&t=2&akid=4221%2E734936%2E1kjXGb)

$5 because we have an opportunity here to get a win in a place where Democrats haven’t won in nearly a century.
$5 because Adam Hamilton doesn’t accept corporate PAC money, and he’s relying on everyday people to get this campaign over the line.
$5 because the path to taking the Senate doesn’t just run down the coast, but through the heart of the country.
[**So please, split $5 between my campaign and Adam Hamilton’s in Kansas.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-hamilton.mp3doH&refcode=em261010-1-90&t=4&akid=4221%2E734936%2E1kjXGb)

**Thursday, October 8, 2026 -**_****_
_**Palestine** : Israeli artillery fire kills woman, wounds several in Gaza City. Israeli forces detain dozens of Palestinians as settler attacks continue across the occupied West Bank. Israeli authorities demolish Palestinian-owned shop in northern Israel. Israel returns body of Palestinian prisoner, continues to withhold 99 others. Israel blocks Gaza crossings three years into the genocide. Israel forces out most UK diplomats from occupied East Jerusalem. New York Times: Top aide to U.S.'s Israel ambassador suppressed and rewrote U.S. Embassy reports critical of Israel._
_**Yemen** : Three killed, 36 injured in attacks on Saudi airports. Ansarallah warns workers to stay away from Saudi oil facilities it considers targets. Saudi-backed Yemeni forces and Ansarallah continue battle for territory around Bab al-Mandab. Turkey rules out troop deployment under Mecca defense pact. Syria says it stands with Saudi Arabia but does not seek to "open new fronts."_
_**Iran** : U.S.-Iran negotiations continue as Tehran weighs latest proposal. Pentagon ordered CENTCOM to prepare for possible resumption of major U.S. attacks on Iran, Axios reports. Multiple projectiles hit tanker off Qatar, casualties reported. International flights resume at Tehran airport after 40-day suspension. U.S. prepares release of last batch of Strategic Petroleum Reserve._
_**Lebanon:** Israeli attacks towns across three southern Lebanon districts in continued violation of "ceasefire." Hezbollah receives $200 million from Iran for displaced Lebanese, Reuters reports._
_**U.S.** : NY Fed survey: Americans worse off than last year, expect higher inflation. Texas Senate nominee Ken Paxton privately blames Iran war, gas prices for campaign troubles. Emails show ICE cut training, dropped real-world scenarios. ICE amassed tens of millions of voter records in sweeping fraud hunt, documents show. Government Accountability Office finds President Donald Trump's administration illegally withheld over $1 billion at the Environmental Protection Agency and the Department of Health and Human Services. Wall Street Journal: U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle begged Trump donor to pay $100,000 credit card debt before confirmation. Arizona Democratic congressional candidate reports sexual assault while repairing campaign signs._
_**International:** Russian bomb attack kills at least 33 in Kramatorsk, one of the year's deadliest single strikes. Witnesses report Eritrean troops in Ethiopian town of Adigrat, Eritrea denies. Nigerian troops kill more than 25 militants in Borno; gunmen kill over 25 soldiers, 100 miners in Zamfara. Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro, wife expected to face new U.S. charges over alleged torture of detained Americans. Trump administration opens direct talks with Myanmar's military-installed government. Seventh man arrested over suspected RAF Fairford plot released on bail.
