By Jacqueline Garretson, Opinion Contributor

It has been more than five years since COVID-19 changed our lives, but for many Illinois families, the consequences never really went away. Businesses were lost, jobs disappeared, families drained their savings, and children lost something that can never be replaced: their childhood.

Under Gov. JB Pritzker, Illinois families spent 1,155 days under some form of COVID-era emergency declarations, restrictions, and executive orders. For more than three years, Illinoisans lived with a government response that repeatedly changed how we worked, learned, worshiped, and interacted with one another. What was initially presented as a temporary emergency became a prolonged period of government intervention that affected every aspect of daily life.

But the people who paid the greatest price were often those with the least ability to understand what was happening: our children.

In a matter of weeks, their entire world changed. Schools closed. Sports disappeared. Friends became faces on computer screens. Birthday parties, school activities, graduations, and family gatherings were canceled.

Children were isolated during some of the most important developmental years of their lives, and many are still dealing with the consequences. Parents watched their children struggle with anxiety, fear, isolation, and academic setbacks. Years later, many students remain behind where they should be.

Yet instead of confronting those failures honestly, Illinois continues to lower the bar and declare victory.

Changing standards doesn’t change reality. If students are struggling academically, lowering expectations doesn’t make them more successful. It simply makes the numbers look better. Parents in Illinois deserve an education system that tells the truth about where our children are; not one that manipulates the measurements to make politicians look more successful.

And here’s the part voters should not forget: Democrats weren’t the only politicians who supported the COVID response. Some Republicans did too.

Former Illinois House Republican Leader Jim Durkin, along with others in the party, supported restrictions, defended the status quo, and failed to challenge the system, while families and businesses were suffering. Politicians shouldn’t be more concerned with maintaining political relationships than standing up for the people who elected them.

Today, former Illinois House Republican Leader Jim Durkin has endorsed JB Pritzker for Governor. Durkin’s endorsement is a political nod of approval to the very Governor whose COVID policies left such a lasting mark on Illinois families.

To me, that endorsement says a lot. It is a reminder that the old political establishment has never been as divided as the party labels would have us believe.

There was, however, a Republican who was willing to challenge the governor when it mattered: Darren Bailey.

I watched Darren stand on the House floor and tell the political establishment that the path Illinois was taking was wrong. He challenged Pritzker’s restrictions. And while others were willing to go along to get along, Darren was willing to stand up and fight.

You don’t have to agree with Darren Bailey on every issue to recognize the importance of political courage.

Leadership isn’t simply agreeing with the majority when it is politically convenient. Sometimes leadership means standing alone and telling the people in power that they have gone too far.

The next crisis will eventually come. When it does, Illinois families need leaders who understand that government power must have limits and that emergency authority cannot become a blank check.

We need leaders who will listen to parents, protect children, support small businesses, and question the establishment when its power becomes unchecked.

Because those 1,155 days weren’t just numbers on a calendar. They represented birthdays that couldn’t be celebrated, seasons that couldn’t be played, businesses that never reopened, jobs that disappeared, and children who lost years they will never get back.

Five years later, Illinois families are still picking up the pieces. They don’t need politicians to tell them everything worked. They know it didn’t.

They deserve the truth. They deserve accountability. And they deserve leaders who will put people before politics.

That leader is Darren Bailey.

Hi Peter, We talk a lot about the impacts of abortion bans and the fight over mifepristone, and those battles are real and ongoing. But I want to make sure you know about some of the other ways this administration is attacking reproductive healthcare right now, because the hits are coming from every direction at once.
1. **RFK Jr. is blocking teen pregnancy prevention funding.** Congress passed $100 million for these programs, but less than 1% of that money has been spent this past fiscal year. HHS is obligated to spend that money, as directed by Congress – it’s not optional.

As an OB-GYN, I’m extremely concerned about what this means for young people, their safety, their health, and their well-being. I’m leading more than 90 House and Senate Democrats in demanding that RFK Jr. release this funding immediately. We will not let this administration put teenagers’ lives at risk to advance their dangerous agenda.

2. **There’s an estrogen patch shortage here in the U.S. and no plan to fix it.** Estrogen patches help millions of women manage menopause symptoms, and for many of them, these patches are life-changing. It is unacceptable that the FDA has no plan to address this shortage, so the House Democratic Women’s Caucus is demanding answers from RFK Jr. immediately.

3. **Trump’s FDA pick won’t say that birth control _isn’t_ abortion.** His nominee to lead the FDA, Heidi Overton, holds extreme anti-science views on vaccines and reproductive health. During her confirmation hearing, Senator Patty Murray asked her directly whether she agrees with the Trump administration falsely calling an IUD an abortifacient, and she wouldn’t answer.

Trump wants to hand control over Americans’ access to birth control, vaccine regulations, food safety, and prescription drug supply to someone who refuses to acknowledge that birth control is not abortion. She is completely unfit for the role, and the Senate must reject her nomination.

Every one of these attacks is part of a coordinated effort to restrict access to reproductive healthcare for every American, and they will continue unless we flip the House and put real guardrails on this administration.

clean_body: These aren’t the fights you usually hear about – but they’re just as dangerous| | | | = Hi Peter, We talk a lot about the impacts of abortion bans and the fight over mifepristone, and those battles are real and ongoing. But I want to make sure you know about some of the other ways this administration is attacking reproductive healthcare right now, because the hits are coming from every direction at once. 1. RFK Jr. is blocking teen pregnancy prevention funding. Congress passed $100 million for these programs, but less than 1% of that money has been spent this past fiscal year. HHS is obligated to spend that money, as directed by Congress – it’s not optional. As an OB-GYN, I’m extremely concerned about what this means for young people, their safety, their health, and their well-being. I’m leading more than 90 House and Senate Democrats in demanding that RFK Jr. release this funding immediately. We will not let this administration put teenagers’ lives at risk to advance their dangerous agenda. 2. There’s an estrogen patch shortage here in the U.S. and no plan to fix it. Estrogen patches help millions of women manage menopause symptoms, and for many of them, these patches are life-changing. It is unacceptable that the FDA has no plan to address this shortage, so the House Democratic Women’s Caucus is demanding answers from RFK Jr. immediately. 3. Trump’s FDA pick won’t say that birth control isn’t abortion. His nominee to lead the FDA, Heidi Overton, holds extreme anti-science views on vaccines and reproductive health. During her confirmation hearing, Senator Patty Murray asked her directly whether she agrees with the Trump administration falsely calling an IUD an abortifacient, and she wouldn’t answer. Trump wants to hand control over Americans’ access to birth control, vaccine regulations, food safety, and prescription drug supply to someone who refuses to acknowledge that birth control is not abortion. She is completely unfit for the role, and the Senate must reject her nomination. Every one of these attacks is part of a coordinated effort to restrict access to reproductive healthcare for every American, and they will continue unless we flip the House and put real guardrails on this administration. = If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. | | | = | | = | | | = | | = | | | = | | | I’m not going to stop fighting – not on teen pregnancy prevention, not on menopause care, not on birth control – not on any of it. subject: Brighter Days are Ahead for South Dakota

body:

| | | |
---
| | | |
---
| |
---
DWU Town Hall

Thank you to everyone who attended the town hall at the McGovern Library at DWU in Mitchell. It was an honor speaking at the library named after the incredible Sen. George McGovern whose decades of work is still helping millions of people around the world.

I especially appreciated the students who took the time to share their concerns, ask thoughtful questions, and talk about the issues that matter to them. I’m grateful to everyone who joined us for the conversation.

| | |
---
| |
---
NSU Town Hall

Thank you to the NSU College Democrats for hosting this town hall in Aberdeen. We had great conversations about the importance of monitoring water usage and supporting conservation efforts in South Dakota. Having a healthy and protected environment is crucial to our farmers, national parks, and our overall quality of life.

It’s truly inspiring to see young people stepping up to the issues we face in South Dakota. Young folks who ask important questions and make their voices heard are vital to a thriving South Dakota.

| | | |
---
| |
---
Dakota Days & Gypsy Days

It’s homecoming season! This is one of my favorite times of the year because it gives me an opportunity to meet many different people from various communities across the state. I always find myself falling behind the float as I stop to visit with South Dakotans. These events demonstrate the vibrancy of our state and the unique identities of our towns and cities.

I am excited to walk in the DWU and SDSU parades later this month and meet more of South Dakota!

| | |
---
| |
---
Pumpkin Festival

After D-Days in Vermillion, my Lt. Governor pick Steve McCleerey and I headed to Webster for the Pumpkin Festival and parade!

I love these small-town celebrations. It’s wonderful seeing an entire community come together to celebrate their roots and the future ahead. There was a great crowd, lots of energy, and a very warm welcome. Events like this are a great reminder of what makes our South Dakota communities so special.

| | | | SDPB Governor’s Debate

---
[| |
---](https://us.list-manage.com/19izT2Eyh0D?e=cee7b49c04&c2id=3adc23449cf80dcda430cceaf3c4b05d)
Thank you to South Dakota Public Broadcasting for hosting a debate between me and my opponent Larry Rhoden. We had a robust conversation about affordability, investing in local businesses, properly funding education and making healthcare more accessible.

I spoke about the missed opportunities to bring good paying jobs to South Dakota and my plans to strengthen small businesses right here in our state. I laid out my proposal to bring down the cost of childcare by creating a childcare tax rebate program. I offered solutions to protect our farmers and ranchers.

What did my opponent offer? Sticking with the status quo.

Ask yourself, are you better off than you were a year ago, five years ago, ten years ago? South Dakotans deserve a leader who will listen to your concerns and find solutions. [If you missed the debate, click here to watch it on SDPB.](https://us.list-manage.com/17SvGG9JjgL?e=cee7b49c04&c2id=3adc23449cf80dcda430cceaf3c4b05d)

| | | | Early Voting Has Begun!

---
Five votes. That’s all it took to change the outcome of a Sioux Falls mayoral election. After the 2026 runoff, the final margin between Christine Erickson and Jamie Smith was just four votes after the recount. Think about that for a moment. Five more people voting for Jamie Smith could have changed who became mayor of South Dakota’s largest city.

It is easy to believe that one vote doesn’t matter, especially when we look at the thousands of people who vote in an election. But elections aren’t decided by thousands of people voting as one person. They are decided one vote at a time.

Your vote matters, and sometimes it matters more than you could ever imagine. Your vote also matters because it is one of the most important ways, we can hold our elected leaders accountable. South Dakota has a long history of giving citizens the power to make laws and change our Constitution directly through ballot measures. But for years, our elected leaders have tried to make that process more difficult when they don’t like the results. We are seeing that fight again this year with Amendment L, which would change the requirement for constitutional amendments from a simple majority to 60% of the vote. I believe South Dakotans should have the right to make decisions about our state, not have that voice made harder to exercise by the people we elect. Democracy works best when more people participate, not when we put more obstacles between citizens and their government.

We can change all of this in November. We can elect leaders who listen to the people, respect the will of voters, and understand that government is supposed to work for all South Dakotans. But it starts with showing up. Our polling numbers are really good. If Democrats show up, we can win this race. We can change our priorities, change the direction of our state, and make sure every South Dakotan has a voice in their government. Be the difference. Make your voice heard. Vote.

| | Folks, I learned two things my first summer at the Naval Academy that have stayed with me ever since. The first was the oath:_to support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic._ The second was the honor code: **tell the truth, do the right thing, and accept the consequences, even when it costs you.** I've lived by both for more than 30 years. I lived by them when I chose to serve on the January 6th Committee, knowing it could cost me my seat in Congress. It did, and I'd make the same choice again. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140961017/652084025/-373287771?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_261008_FR_HonorCongress_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMTc3ZTQxMy0zMmMzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0Lbngsb8CFuw13tEb0QsREFG4iD6BPrcpTrIkVaMK0A=) Jen Kiggans is a fellow Navy veteran. She raised her right hand and swore the same oath I did. But somewhere along the way, she traded the honor code for the Washington code: vote how you're told. **This Congress, Kiggans has voted with Trump and the Republican Party 100% of the time.** That includes:
* Casting a decisive vote to gut health care for 400,000+ Virginians to pay for tax breaks for billionaires
* Calling the DOGE cuts that hit veteran services and Hampton Roads workers "so necessary"
* Staying silent while this administration tramples the Constitution she swore to defend

That's not leadership, and it's not honor. It's going along to get along. And she’s been rewarded handsomely for it: Trump endorsed her as his “warrior” and his PAC has poured $1.5M into this race to keep her in his back pocket. I'm not asking you to agree with me on every issue. I'm asking you to send someone to Washington who will tell you the truth and do the job she swore to do. **We have 26 days left. name: Riley Gaines
subject: Fellow Conservative, I refuse to stay silent
body:
What happened to me in the pool was only the beginning of my fight.

View in Web Browser
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e6180424/UaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvNUJQWk1uY3RDWg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjEwMDg/LbmNseWdCU1J6bg/qP2hpZHM9bmMwWnJTM0JiSEJYNnhsc10/gasfDJQ/s9o24b9aec0

[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Dear Fellow Conservative,

Even though we don’t know each other yet, I’m writing to ask you
to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.

Actually, in my case, it’s a slippery slide.

Because my name is Riley Gaines and I’m the University of Kentucky
swimmer who had to compete against a fully intact 6’4” male
swimmer dressed in a women’s bathing suit.

And after he stole the victory I had worked for my entire life, I had
to go back to the women’s locker room and undress out of my wet
bathing suit while he did the same next to me.

Maybe you want to stop reading right now.

I know the images I’m bringing up are horrible.

But please don’t stop.

Because God-fearing, faith-filled people like you and me have a job to
do today.

We can’t retreat into our homes and hope President Trump will fix
everything and the Left’s evil culture will just pass us by.

That’s why I’m asking you to give in the next 48 hours.

My fellow conservative, you know this slippery slide.

It’s the same one you got pushed down when the Left told you
abortion was going to be “safe, legal, and rare.” Now abortion is
a “right” and “women’s healthcare.” And if you don’t
support it up until the moment of birth, you must “hate women.”

It’s the same slippery slide you got pushed down when the Left told
you limiting gay couples to civil unions was “mean.” You were
told, “They just want to use the word “marriage” like everyone
else. It’s just a word.” Now if you don’t fully embrace the
homosexual lifestyle by displaying rainbows and celebrating gay pride,
you’re a “hate-filled bigot.”

Enough with their lies. We have Truth on our side. And we need to
start acting like it.

God created man. And God created woman.

It isn’t any more complicated than that.

Letting men believe they are women... letting girls believe they are
boys... is a bold-faced rejection of God’s truth.

President Trump is fighting these lies with temporary Executive
Orders. But radical courts are already undermining him. We must stop
this deranged movement from gaining one more inch.

We’ve got to counter them in the courts or rogue judges will rule
that kids can be taken away from parents who oppose this evil... that
schools can hide “transition” from parents... and that doctors can
mutilate children with no consequences.

Your chance is right now – and right by my side.

Please stand with me against the radical transgender movement by
making a gift in the next 48 hours.

YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Please don’t tell me, “Riley, this isn’t a widespread
problem.”

Look at this photo.

[Lavine and Brinton]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

This is pediatrician, 4-star admiral, and former Assistant Secretary
for Health -- Rachel Levine (born Richard Levine). This man in a
women’s Navy uniform has been a “leader” in your government.

And the person standing next to Levine? That’s Sam Brinton. He’s a
man in a dress who was a Biden-Harris nuclear official until he got
caught stealing luggage at Ronald Reagan Airport filled with ladies
clothes.

Then consider that 11 states and counting, plus the District of
Columbia, are transgender “sanctuary” states. That means in some
of them, minor children can flee there and get transgender services --
even sex change operations -- without their parents’ permission.

And did you know Medicare now covers sex change operations?

It just goes on and on... This evil is widespread.

Or maybe you’re thinking like so many, “Riley, adults are free to
do whatever they want. And children should be kept away from this evil
by their parents.”

As for the transgender adults, your generation used to call these
people perverts, predators, and pedophiles.

Should they be representing our government? Alone in classrooms with
our children?

And as for parents, I agree this problem would have less traction if
parents just said, “No.”

But parents in Maryland had their child taken away because they
refused to let their son transition to a “girl.”

Parents in states like Vermont and Colorado saw their foster care
licenses revoked because they admitted they would not help a child who
may be assigned to their home get puberty blockers or have sex change
surgery.

Parents in California got themselves elected to the school board,
passed guidelines to protect their children from the transgender
movement, and now the state of California is suing them.

Even with President Trump’s temporary Executive Orders attempting to
ban men from women’s sports and bathrooms, and halt grotesque
medical procedures for children... you can see, the radical
transgender movement has parents backed into a corner.

I’m sorry I’ve gone on so long detailing the transgender threat.
But when I’m speaking around the country, I meet so many seniors who
say, “I wish someone had told me about this sooner.”

But the good news is that right now, you still have a chance to help
stop the radical transgender movement before they push us down their
slippery slide.

And today I’m writing you on behalf of a group that is doing more
work to block the transgender movement than anyone I know.

It’s the legal non-profit the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY.

YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

And your gift is going straight to help them.

With the help of patriots like you, the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY
fights the transgender movement in the courts because that’s the
only way to stop them.

And the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY is attacking this evil from all
sides with their comprehensive three-pronged approach.

#1. THEY’RE FIGHTING RADICAL SCHOOLS.

I know it may sound crazy to you but in today’s taxpayer-funded
schools, teachers, and counselors encourage young children to socially
“transition” at school and then facilitate the “transition” by
giving children new names and even giving them new clothes so they can
dress as the opposite sex.

And they keep it all a secret from parents!

You probably remember a time when kids needed a note from home just to
get an aspirin at school!

The CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY is taking these radicals to court in
multiple cases. And they already have one major win!

When you give, you’re making sure PARENTS have the final word in
guiding their children -- not school radicals!

#2. THEY’RE FIGHTING RADICAL DOCTORS.

My fellow conservative, I hope you love and trust your doctors. There
are lots of good ones out there.

But there are also doctors who mutilate children for profit in the
name of transgender “care.” They use their “expertise” to
convince even conservative parents that if they oppose
“transition,” their child will commit suicide.

Then these doctors pump children full of dangerous puberty blockers
and perform gruesome surgeries to remove children’s healthy breasts
and other parts.

Again, I apologize for the graphic description, but this is the pure
evil we’re facing.

Maybe you’ve seen a girl named Chloe Cole on Fox News. In a landmark
case, the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY is helping her sue the radical
doctors and hospital that gave her a double mastectomy at age 15.

President Trump signed an Executive Order aimed at protecting children
from these grotesque doctors but a Biden-appointed federal judge has
already blocked its enforcement.

The best way to protect children is to contribute to help Chloe and
the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY win their case to make sure this never
happens to another child!

#3. THEY’RE FIGHTING FOR YOUR RIGHT TO SPEAK OUT AGAINST THIS
HEINOUS EVIL.

You’ll be happy to know that fighting for Freedom of Speech is one
of the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY’S specialties.

They’ve notched plenty of victories in this space including fighting
for an 82-year-old grandmother who got banned for life from the YMCA.

This grandma raised the alarm that a grown man dressed in a women’s
bathing suit was in the women’s locker room “helping” two little
girls get ready to use the bathroom.

And she was the one punished!

But thanks to supporters just like you, the CENTER FOR AMERICAN
LIBERTY fought back and won! And when you give, you’re helping them
win all their critical cases confronting the evil of the transgender
movement.

YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

I know you’d probably love to fund an entire court case on your own
after all I’ve told you, but all I’m asking you to do is RENEW
YOUR SUPPORT with a tax-deductible gift of $30, $50, $75, $100 or even
$250 or more.

Please donate whatever amount is right for you whether it’s smaller
or larger. The CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY needs and appreciates
every dollar that comes in.

And because I believe so strongly in the work they’re doing – and
because they are one of the few groups who’ve stood
shoulder-to-shoulder with me in this fight...

It will be my honor to send you my new book “Swimming Against the
Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That’s Lost Its
Mind” as my free gift when you donate $50 or more to the CENTER FOR
AMERICAN LIBERTY.

[Lavine and Brinton]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Before I go, please let me share one last thought with you.

Every morning as a competitive swimmer, I would get up and think of
this verse:

_For I consider that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy
to be compared to the glory that is about to be revealed to us._
(Romans 8:18)

I applied it to my swimming: work hard now and wins come later. But
now I see that God has a much bigger plan for my life just as He does
for yours.

This battle isn’t about a swimming victory. It’s about Kingdom
victory. I will never stop fighting to protect God’s Truth and I
think you feel the same way.

Thank you for reading my letter all the way to the end. I’m praying
for you, and I hope you’ll pray for me too.

Sincerely,

Riley Gaines

P.S. I’m so grateful that President Trump signed temporary Executive
Orders aimed at stopping the radical transgender movement. But the
Left is launching attacks in the courts to undermine him and we must
fight back.

God made man and God made woman. The attempts to deny those basic
truths, are attempts to deny the truth of God.

Your help is so critical to the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY’S work,
when you donate $50 or more, as my personal “Thank You,” I’ll
send you my new book, “Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for
Common Sense in a World That’s Lost Its Mind” for free. Please
hurry. It’s getting hard to hold back this evil without you. I
don’t want you to look back a year from now and say, “I wish I had
done something when I had the chance.”

SUPPORT CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

The Center for American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit charitable
organization fighting against growing anti-free speech and anti-civil
liberties trends. Your gift is tax-deductible.

PO Box 200942
Pittsburgh, PA 15251-0942

108 S Washington St. Suite 200
Alexandria, VA 22314

Case File No DRT-ED-CHAIN · Special File · The Weakest Link
No One at the Wheel: Every Self-Driving Car Depends on a Chain Most People Never See
Tesla’s robotaxis have passed 1 million unsupervised miles and Giga Texas can build 125,000 Cybercabs a year. But none of it runs without a few highly specialized suppliers. In a race with many carmakers, the chokepoint is where the leverage sits.
Threat level 3/5 — Guarded
| | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
|
---
A car with nobody in the driver’s seat used to be science fiction. In 2026 it’s a ride you can hail in Austin. Watching one is unsettling at first, then oddly ordinary. But behind every one of those cars sits a chain of suppliers so specialized that if any link breaks, the whole thing stops. Most people never think about who those suppliers are.
The evidence board
| | Where Driverless Stands Today
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — the miles.** In September, Tesla said its robotaxi fleet had passed 1 million unsupervised miles. Its service runs in seven U.S. metros. Its purpose-built Cybercab, with no steering wheel or pedals, entered the Austin fleet on September 4.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the factory.** Giga Texas has installed capacity for more than 125,000 Cybercabs a year. For scale, Waymo runs about 4,000 vehicles and more than 500,000 paid rides a week.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — the dependency.** Every self-driving car runs an AI computer that makes driving decisions on board, in real time. Tesla’s next chip, AI5, is in trial production at Samsung’s new plant in Taylor, Texas, under a $16.5 billion deal. Only a handful of factories on earth can make chips that advanced.
The chain
| | What a Driverless Car Can’t Run Without
---|---
| The brainAdvanced AI chipsMade at the most advanced factories in the world. There are very few of them.
---
| The memoryHigh-bandwidth memoryTesla says AI5 has about 9x the memory bandwidth of the current chip. Data has to move as fast as the car thinks.
---
| The eyesCameras and sensorsFeeding the brain a constant stream of images, in rain, glare and darkness.
---
| The trainingData-center computeEvery mile driven becomes training data for the next version.
---
Decoder
| | Why a Chokepoint Is an Opportunity
---|---
| | “More than 1 million unsupervised miles.”— Tesla, at its September Cybercab event
---|---
What it says
Self-driving is working at real scale.
What it means
**Our theory:** the more these cars drive, the more every company in the chain matters. Carmakers compete fiercely with each other. But when a critical component comes from only one or two suppliers, every carmaker has to buy from them. That’s the kind of position that tends to get repriced once the volume shows up.
| ClassificationTransition
---
Driverless cars are on public roads and factories are ready to build them by the hundred thousand. The carmaker gets the attention. The company sitting at the narrowest point of the supply chain may get the leverage, and few investors have noticed it yet.
| The riddle · answer at the end of the fileIf dozens of companies are racing to build self-driving cars, why might the safest bet be a company that doesn’t build cars at all?
---
|
---
Riddle answer
**Because it sells to all of them.** A carmaker has to beat its rivals. A supplier of a critical part wins whenever any of them sells a car. **Our theory:** in every big technology shift, the companies at the chokepoints of the supply chain often turn out to be the steadier way to own the trend.

**WAIT UNTIL 8TH WITH SAM RASOUL + RCC-PTA - Oct. 14** Join the community movement pledging not to give our children a smartphone until after 8th grade. Del. Sam Rasoul, Emily Harrison (Distraction Free Schools), Jessica Blandy (Roanoke City Council of PTAs/PTSAs), and Wesley Williams (RCPS Executive Director of Operations), will speak with community members about the benefits of not giving cell phones to children before they finish 8th grade. The event is **Wednesday, Oct. 14 at 5:30 pm at Grandin Court Elementary School.**

**A CALL TO ENGAGE ACROSS DIFFERENCES - Oct. 13 & 20** Points of Diversity, in partnership with SERV, invites all to participate in A Call to Engage Across Differences, a two-part interactive workshop designed to bridge divides in our community. Participants will explore how core values shape personal beliefs and gain practical skills for active listening, asking thoughtful questions, and navigating complex political, cultural, and ideological differences with curiosity, empathy, and respect. The events will be held on October 13 and October 20 from 6-7 pm at the Unitarian Universalist Church.

body:
When I ran for Congress, I promised results, not more empty talk from Washington. I want to show you exactly what that's looked like so far. | | |
---
| |
# With your support, we are delivering results.
---
| Friend,

When I ran for Congress, I promised results, not more empty talk from Washington. I want to show you exactly what that's looked like so far. Fighting for our water. I secured $1 billion in western water infrastructure funding, including $540 million going directly to California dams, canals, and water projects. I got $5 million to combat invasive golden mussels threatening our water systems, and delivered local wins for the Pine Flat Dam Raise, Eastman Lake Enlargement, and groundwater recharge projects across Fresno, Tulare, and Kaweah. I introduced the Water Infrastructure Resiliency Act to protect our water systems for the long haul, and I'm still fighting Sacramento's bureaucrats every time they try to take our water away. Standing up for our military and national security. I delivered nearly $98 million for NAS Lemoore's Strike Fighter Center of Excellence and F-35 hangar, and for a new Child Development Center at NAWS China Lake. I secured $39.5 million more for hypersonic testing, rocket lab infrastructure, and readiness programs at Edwards Air Force Base and China Lake, protecting the installations that anchor our local economy and our national defense. Bringing NASA innovation home. My ANCHOR Act, which protects cybersecurity on America's academic research fleet, passed the House 412-11. My ACERO Act, using NASA drone technology to help fight wildfires, advanced out of committee unanimously, 34-0. Cutting the red tape that's driving up your costs. I took on Gavin Newsom's "hidden climate tax" on cargo ships, forced accountability that led the Trump administration to finally pull the plug on California's high-speed rail boondoggle, and I'm pushing back on the State Water Board every time it tries to move the goalposts on Central Valley families. This is what showing up and doing the work looks like. I'm not finished. Not by a long shot. Thank you for standing with me, Sincerely

Congressman Vince Fong
